correctness.rationale: For every q<1, circle symmetry reduces w_q to the real support; strict convexity and leading singular-pair overlaps certify the exact dual minimization in a scalar shift. An explicit exact cubic characteristic determinant depends on the fixed Frobenius weights only through pi=|ab|², with strictly decreasing leading root in pi at every finite shift. Coercivity permits a strict comparison of minimized envelopes. Rank-one singular-value algebra, balanced singular-value splitting at zero, and a direct Hermitian-part spectral calculation settle the exact endpoint profiles and all equality cases. The standalone CHECK.py passes 1,645 finite diagnostic assertions. No finite experiment is used as the infinite/continuum proof.

value.rationale: Fixed Hilbert–Schmidt/Frobenius energy is a natural resource constraint for sparse nilpotent matrix models in scaled-q numerical-range and dilation questions. The contribution is a complete q-by-energy extremal phase diagram for all complex three-site one-step shifts, with strict interior weight rigidity, an exact unique balanced optimizer, a sharp rank-one opposite endpoint, the exceptional plateau q<=1/2, and complete loss of rigidity only at the ordinary numerical radius endpoint q=1. This is more than a reparametrized q-radius value and requires the cubic monotonicity proof.
